nodes.title: Even-prism formulas
nodes.statement: S=m, P=M=2, cmin=1, H=2m+2; full proof in FAMILIES.md.

nodes.title: Exact boundary transfer identities
nodes.statement: Face matchings, pair-cycle distributions and two induced trees have finite stationary transfers.

nodes.title: Exact integer tube certificates
nodes.statement: Widths 4 and 6 have saved matrices, finite recurrence certificates and cmin=1 Boolean stabilization.

nodes.title: Prism-chain factorization
nodes.statement: S=3^q, P=M=2^q, cmin=q, signed product with gaps 5j+2.

nodes.title: Three-port chain HC tensor
nodes.statement: Local eight-cycle tensor gives H_q=20*3^(q-2), q>=2.

nodes.title: Rarity without triangular separators
nodes.statement: Width-4 transfer has M=2 and S=Fib_(2L+3).

nodes.title: Subdivision does not preserve growing cmin
nodes.statement: Subdivided q=1,2,3 cube chains all have cmin=1.
nodes.lesson: New states can join old D-cycles after subdivision.

nodes.title: Unbounded cmin without separators
nodes.statement: No family found here; investigate separators of length four.

nodes.title: Width-6 signed-polynomial recurrence
nodes.statement: Only exact polynomials through L=4 are supplied.

nodes.title: M >= 2^cmin
nodes.statement: Exact for every exponent in the nested prism chain; general conjecture remains open.
nodes.test: Find a rooted triangulation with a pair and M<2^cmin.
